name: Dual Moving Average Crossover
hypothesis: Momentum persists; when a short-term moving average crosses a long-term moving average, the trend is shifting and will continue in that direction.
best_when: Markets are in a clear, sustained trend
worst_when: Markets are ranging, choppy, or consolidating
entry_conditions: Short-term SMA (e.g., 40 days) crosses above Long-term SMA (e.g., 100 days) for Long entry
Short-term SMA crosses below Long-term SMA for Short entry
exit_tp_logic: Exit when the moving averages cross in the opposite direction
exit_sl_logic: Not explicitly defined in text, typically requires a fixed or ATR-based stop
reported_note: Described as the 'hello world' of quantitative trading in the text
